_doc: Accounting rules of the Finance API (admin/server/modules/financeApi.js), per company code of allegro_finance.companies.
The accountant can correct these without a code change. finance_api_readme.md section 5 explains each block.
confirmed: false marks a rule that still waits for the owner or the accountant.

pastalina._foodCostAccounts: null = every account of group 800. The accountant's list of food accounts goes here, e.g. ["800000", "800001", ...].
pastalina._invoiceTypes: ת (1,628 entries, 2025) is not in Hashavshevet's type table, but its entries are expense + supplier + input VAT, like ח18. Confirm with the accountant.
pastalina._branches: Rule 1: the entry's cost code. Rule 2: the account (its own cost code, the accounts list, or a word of the branch in the account name). Rule 3: a word in the entry description. Decision 5 (104 = הרצליה) is open.
pastalina._intercompany: Candidates from the data (decision 3). The owner must confirm the list.

allocationNumber._note: The legal limit (invoice total with VAT) per date. Not confirmed with the accountant.

pastalina._drive: The invoice agent's Drive folder of this company (invoice-agent/README.md) and the rules of /finance/invoices/drive-check: folder = the folder name under "Invoices" (or any row whose our-side tax id is taxId); tolerance = the allowed difference in ₪ between the invoice total (with VAT) and the book entry; days = how far the entry date may be from the invoice date; recentDays = an invoice dated in the last N days of the books counts as pending, not missing. Not confirmed with the accountant.
pastalina._validated: Endpoint paths the accountant has checked, e.g. ["/trial-balance"]. They stop carrying the not_validated warning.
